title: Product Sans / Introduction
slide_intent: Explain the job of a companion typeface so designers know when similarity supports the brand and when distinction is needed.
strategic_value: A stated relationship between the logo, product names and interface text can help Google avoid competing typographic voices.
demonstration: A blue monospaced paragraph on white explains Product Sans’s role, followed by Google Design references at lower left.
practical_value: Use the stated role to distinguish branding lockups from general interface typography.

content_islands.name: Running metadata
content_islands.spec: Keep four small labels aligned across the top.

content_islands.name: Rationale text
content_islands.spec: Place the multi-paragraph introduction in the broad left-center field with ample blank space at right and below.

content_islands.name: Source references
content_islands.spec: Place the two Google Design references near the lower-left corner.

reference_purposes.Intent: The text explains that Product Sans pairs with the logo without overshadowing it and differs from Material Design interface text.
reference_purposes.Application: The introduction identifies product lockups and supporting branding as its intended contexts.

ingredient.name: Product Sans
ingredient.role: Support the logo in product names without overwhelming it.
ingredient.application: Use the companion typeface in branding contexts where a close but distinct relationship to the Google logo is needed.
ingredient.scope: The 2015 specimen’s stated role; it does not prescribe Product Sans for all interface text.
